[[File:Chisel detail.png|left|120px]]
A '''chisel''' is a tool used in the [[Crafting]] [[skill]] to cut and shape hard non-metals, mainly [[gem]]s and [[limestone]]. Chisels are also used in [[Fletching]] to cut gems into [[gem bolt tips|bolt tips]]. Chisels can be purchased for 1 [[coin]] at all [[general store]]s, except for those in [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] and [[Ardougne]]. There is a [[free-to-play]] chisel spawn in the [[Crafting Guild]]. 

At level 15 [[Construction]], [[members]] can make a [[tool store 1]] for the [[workshop]] room of their [[house]], which will provide an unlimited supply of chisels.
